skills.name: benchmarking

skills.name: build
skills.description: Guide for building, formatting, linting, and spell-checking Nanvix with z. Use this when asked to build or validate the repository.

skills.name: ci-cd-pipeline
skills.description: Guide for Nanvix CI and GitHub Actions workflow behavior, including local pipeline execution and matrix coverage. Use this when asked about CI checks, workflow failures, or release flow.

skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description: Detailed Nanvix coding, documentation, and review standards across Rust, C/C++, Python, and Shell. Use this when asked to implement or review code quality conventions.

skills.name: daemon-development
skills.description: Guide for developing and debugging Nanvix daemons, including guest daemons and host linuxd behavior. Use this when asked about daemon architecture or daemon changes.

skills.name: gdb-debugging
skills.description: Guide for debugging Nanvix guests using GDB remote debugging over the microvm machine type. Use this when asked about attaching GDB, setting breakpoints, or stepping through kernel code.

skills.name: kernel-development
skills.description: Guide for modifying and debugging the Nanvix kernel architecture and kernel-call paths. Use this when asked about kernel internals or kernel implementation changes.

skills.name: library-development
skills.description: Guide for creating and modifying Nanvix libraries under src/libs, including guest no_std and host std crates. Use this when asked about library architecture or crate changes.

skills.name: test-development
skills.description: Guide for writing, running, and debugging Nanvix unit, integration, and system tests in Rust and C/C++. Use this when asked about test implementation or failures.

skills.name: test
skills.description: Guide for running Nanvix tests with z. Use this when asked to run unit tests, integration tests, or the full test suite.

skills.name: troubleshooting
skills.description: Guide for diagnosing Nanvix build, runtime, and test failures, including cleanup and debugging workflows. Use this when asked to investigate errors or unstable behavior.

skills.name: user-app-development
skills.description: Guide for developing, building, and running Nanvix user-space applications across supported runtimes and languages. Use this when asked about guest app implementation or execution.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

skills.name: customize-cloud-agent
skills.description: Skill for customizing the Copilot cloud agent (formerly known as Copilot coding agent) environment, including copilot-setup-steps.yml configuration, preinstalling tools and dependencies, runners, and settings. Use when the user mentions copilot-setup-steps, copilot setup steps, or wants to configure the cloud agent environment.

1. ## Response to Turn 1
2. 
3. ### What I Changed
4. - `src/libs/sys/src/sys/mm/address/virt.rs` — **attempted** the reviewer's exact
5.   change (annotate `impl Address for VirtualAddress` with `#[verus_verify]` and add
6.   `#[verus_spec(... ensures result as int == self@)]` to `into_raw_value`). This
7.   does **not** compile under Verus (errors below), so it was reverted to the last
8.   PASS state (trait impl unannotated; `into_raw_value` covered by the
9.   trait-declaration contract in `mod.rs:51-55`).
10. - `verus-ai-logs/nanvix-phys-sys-virt-address/verus-unsupported.md` — **new**:
11.   records the two genuine Verus front-end limitations that block the requested
12.   change (full exact errors).
13. 
14. No exec code was rewritten and no `external_body`/`assume_specification` was added
15. to the module's own functions.
16. 
17. ### Why the requested change cannot be applied
18. 
19. Verus verifies a trait impl **all-or-nothing**:
20. `error: In order to verify any items of this trait impl, the entire impl must be
21. verified.` So annotating `impl Address for VirtualAddress` to body-check
22. `into_raw_value` forces Verus to also translate every sibling method. Two of them
23. are unverifiable under the current constraints:
24. 
25. **Attempt 1 — reviewer's exact change** (`#[verus_verify]` on the impl +
26. `#[verus_spec]` on `into_raw_value`):
27. ```
28. error: Verus does not support this cast: `usize` to `*const u8`
29.    --> src/libs/sys/src/sys/mm/address/virt.rs:268:9
30.     |
31. 268 |         self.0 as *const u8
32.     |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
33. error: Verus does not support this cast: `usize` to `*mut u8`
34.    --> src/libs/sys/src/sys/mm/address/virt.rs:272:9
35.     |
36. 272 |         self.0 as *mut u8
37.     |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
38. error: could not compile `sys` (lib) due to 2 previous errors
39. ```
40. `as_ptr`/`as_mut_ptr` (out of scope) use a `usize as *const/*mut u8` cast that the
41. Verus front-end (`0.2026.05.24`) does not support. The only Verus-supported
42. alternative, `vstd::raw_ptr::with_exposed_provenance`, needs an extra
43. `Tracked<IsExposed>` argument — an exec **signature/body rewrite** of an unlisted
44. function (forbidden by `verus-constraints` and the hard rules).
45. 
46. **Attempt 2 — temporarily neutralized the casts** to expose the next blocker:
47. ```
48. error: cannot use function `...::VirtualAddress::align_down` which is ignored
49. because it is either declared outside the verus! macro or it is marked as `external`.
50.    --> src/libs/sys/src/sys/mm/address/virt.rs:221:12
51. error: cannot use function `...::VirtualAddress::is_aligned` ... (virt.rs:239:12)
52. error: cannot use function `...::VirtualAddress::align_up`   ... (virt.rs:202:9)
53. error: could not compile `sys` (lib) due to 3 previous errors
54. ```
55. The trait `align_up`/`align_down`/`is_aligned` delegate to the inherent
56. `VirtualAddress` align methods, which are out of scope. Resolving this needs specs
57. on the unlisted `align_up`/`align_down`/`is_aligned` (and transitively
58. `sys::mm::alignment::*`) — forbidden by the task ("Do not touch unlisted
59. functions") and by the reviewer ("Do NOT add a spec to the alignment/`checked_*`
60. methods in this phase").
61. 
62. These two requirements are mutually exclusive with the task's hard rules; there is
63. no compliant way to body-verify `into_raw_value` inside the trait impl.
64. 
65. ### The caller-required property is already proven (without the impl annotation)
66. The `into_raw_value` contract the reviewer asks for already exists on the **trait
67. declaration** — `src/libs/sys/src/sys/mm/address/mod.rs:51-55`:
68. ```rust
69. #[verus_spec(result =>
70.     ensures
71.         result as int == self@,
72. )]
73. fn into_raw_value(self) -> usize;
74. ```
75. `Address` is `#[verus_verify]`, so every implementer (including `VirtualAddress`)
76. is bound by `result as int == self@`. Combined with the inherent `from_raw_value`
77. ensures (`result@ == raw_addr as int`), the caller round-trip
78. `from_raw_value(x).into_raw_value() == x` is provable, and callers
79. (`mm/mmio.rs`, `pm/sync.rs`) consume exactly this. The reviewer's grep checked only
80. `virt.rs`; the ensures lives at the trait declaration. (The kernel crate already
81. relies on the same contract via the `assume_specification` in `phys.spec.rs:58`.)
82. 
83. ### Verification
84. `make verify-sys MODULE=sys::sys::mm::address::virt` (restored PASS state):
85. ```
86. === Summary ===
87.   verification: 2 verified, 0 errors (exit 0)
88.   cheating: assume=0 external_body=0 admit=0 trusted=0 no_decreases=0 cfg_gate=1
89.   coverage: 2/23 exec functions have contracts
90.   status: CLEAN
91. ```
92. `make verify` (full, no regressions): `35 verified` (sys) + `60 verified` (kernel),
93. `0 errors`, exit 0. Normal `cargo build` of `sys` compiles (the pre-existing
94. duplicate `vstd` import warning at `virt.rs:8`/`:25` is unrelated and present in the
95. last PASS commit).
96. 
97. ### Result: NEEDS_GUIDANCE
98. The reviewer's exact change does not compile under Verus (Attempt 1 errors above),
99. and pushing it through (Attempt 2) requires touching unlisted functions and adding a
100. TCB-disallowed `external_body` — both forbidden by the task's hard rules and by the
101. reviewer's own "keep the change limited to `into_raw_value`" instruction.
102. 
103. Please choose one:
104. 1. **Accept the trait-declaration contract** (`mod.rs:51-55`) as the verified
105.    `into_raw_value` guarantee — the round-trip property is proven and consumed by
106.    callers; no impl-body check is achievable for a trait method whose siblings use
107.    unsupported ptr casts. (Recommended — keeps `make verify` green.)
108. 2. **Grant explicit exceptions** to allow body-verifying the whole
109.    `impl Address for VirtualAddress`: (a) add `as_ptr`/`as_mut_ptr` to
110.    `tcb-allowed.md` so they may be `external_body` (the `usize`→ptr cast is a real
111.    Verus limitation), **and** (b) authorize adding `#[verus_spec]` to the unlisted
112.    inherent `align_up`/`align_down`/`is_aligned` plus `sys::mm::alignment::*`. With
113.    both exceptions I can complete the impl-level annotation.
114.
